sentences.english: I love the warm spring weather.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢春天温暖的天气。

sentences.english: Spring is my favorite season because all the flowers start to bloom.
sentences.chinese: 春天是我最喜欢的季节，因为所有的花儿都开始绽放。

sentences.english: After a long and freezing winter, seeing the trees turn green in spring always gives me new energy and hope for the year ahead.
sentences.chinese: 经过漫长而寒冷的冬天，看到树木在春天变绿总是给我新的能量和对未来一年的希望。
sentences.scene: 季节转换带来的心情变化

sentences.english: Summer vacation is finally here!
sentences.chinese: 暑假终于来了！

sentences.english: We go to the beach every summer and stay there for a whole week.
sentences.chinese: 我们每年夏天都去海滩，在那待上整整一周。

sentences.english: Even though summer in the city is way too hot, I still love it because the days are long and we can eat ice cream outside at night.
sentences.chinese: 尽管城里的夏天实在太热，但我还是很喜欢，因为白天很长，晚上还能在外面吃冰淇淋。

sentences.english: The autumn leaves are so beautiful.
sentences.chinese: 秋天的叶子真美。

sentences.english: Autumn is perfect for hiking because the weather is cool and the trees are colorful.
sentences.chinese: 秋天非常适合徒步，因为天气凉爽，树木色彩斑斓。

sentences.english: Every autumn, my family drives up to the mountains to see the leaves change color, and we always stop for hot apple cider on the way home.
sentences.chinese: 每年秋天，我们全家都开车去山上看树叶变色，回家路上还会停下来喝热苹果酒。

sentences.english: I love playing in the winter snow.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在冬天的雪里玩耍。

sentences.english: Winter in Chicago is freezing, but the city looks beautiful covered in snow.
sentences.chinese: 芝加哥的冬天冷极了，但被白雪覆盖的城市看起来很漂亮。

sentences.english: When I was a kid, we used to build snow forts every winter, and my mom would bring us hot chocolate to warm our hands.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候，每个冬天我们都会建雪堡，妈妈还会给我们送来热巧克力暖手。

sentences.english: Fall is a beautiful season.
sentences.chinese: 秋天是个美丽的季节。

sentences.english: The rainy season just started, so we should always carry an umbrella now.
sentences.chinese: 雨季刚刚开始，所以我们现在得随身带伞。

sentences.english: Each season brings different activities and foods that I look forward to, like watermelon in summer and pumpkin pie in fall.
sentences.chinese: 每个季节都带来我期待的不同活动和食物，比如夏天的西瓜和秋天的南瓜派。
sentences.scene: 分享对不同季节的期待

sentences.english: Let's have a picnic in the park.
sentences.chinese: 我们去公园野餐吧。

sentences.english: We packed sandwiches, fruit, and lemonade for a picnic by the lake.
sentences.chinese: 我们为湖边野餐准备了三明治、水果和柠檬水。

sentences.english: The picnic was ruined when it suddenly started to rain, so we had to eat our sandwiches in the car, but we still laughed about it.
sentences.chinese: 突然下起了雨，野餐泡汤了，我们不得不在车里吃三明治，但大家还是笑作一团。

sentences.english: Let's go on a picnic this Sunday.
sentences.chinese: 这个周日我们去野餐吧。

sentences.english: If the weather stays sunny, we will go on a picnic by the river.
sentences.chinese: 如果天气一直晴朗，我们就去河边野餐。

sentences.english: We wanted to go on a picnic, but the park was so crowded that we couldn't find a quiet spot, so we just went home.
sentences.chinese: 我们想去野餐，但公园太挤了，找不到安静的地方，只好回家了。

sentences.english: Help me pick some flowers, please.
sentences.chinese: 请帮我采一些花。

sentences.english: I need to pick a birthday present for my mom; do you have any ideas?
sentences.chinese: 我要给妈妈挑选一份生日礼物，你有什么主意吗？

sentences.english: When we went to the farm, I let my daughter pick the biggest pumpkin she could find, and it was almost as big as her.
sentences.chinese: 去农场的时候，我让女儿挑了一个她能找到的最大的南瓜，那个南瓜几乎和她一样大。

sentences.english: We went to pick apples today.
sentences.chinese: 我们今天去摘苹果了。

sentences.english: Every fall, we go to the orchard to pick apples and bake a pie.
sentences.chinese: 每年秋天，我们都去果园摘苹果，然后烤一个苹果派。

sentences.english: It was our first time to pick apples, and we ate so many while we were picking that we almost didn't need lunch.
sentences.chinese: 那是我们第一次摘苹果，摘的时候吃了太多，午饭几乎都吃不下了。

sentences.english: We built a snowman in the yard.
sentences.chinese: 我们在院子里堆了个雪人。

sentences.english: The snowman we built yesterday already melted because the sun came out.
sentences.chinese: 我们昨天堆的雪人已经化了，因为太阳出来了。

sentences.english: My brother used a carrot for the snowman's nose and two buttons for eyes, and it looked absolutely hilarious and a little scary.
sentences.chinese: 我弟弟用胡萝卜当雪人的鼻子，两个纽扣当眼睛，看起来既滑稽又有点吓人。

sentences.english: Let's make a snowman after school.
sentences.chinese: 放学后我们去堆雪人吧。

sentences.english: It snowed so much last night that we can finally make a snowman in the backyard.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚雪下得很大，我们终于可以在后院堆雪人了。

sentences.english: Even though it was freezing outside, the kids insisted on going out to make a snowman, and they ended up staying outside until it got dark.
sentences.chinese: 尽管外面天寒地冻，孩子们坚持要出去堆雪人，结果他们一直待到天黑才回来。

sentences.english: It's so hot, let's go swimming.
sentences.chinese: 太热了，我们去游泳吧。

sentences.english: We usually go swimming at the community pool on Saturday mornings.
sentences.chinese: 我们通常周六早上去社区游泳池游泳。

sentences.english: I wanted to go swimming in the ocean, but the waves were so big that the lifeguard told everyone to stay out of the water.
sentences.chinese: 我想去海里游泳，但浪太大了，救生员叫大家都不要下水。

sentences.english: Which one do you like better?
sentences.chinese: 你更喜欢哪一个？

sentences.english: Which movie should we watch tonight? There are so many good choices.
sentences.chinese: 我们今晚看哪部电影？有很多不错的选择。

sentences.english: I can't decide which ice cream flavor to get because they all look so good, and the line behind me is moving way too fast.
sentences.chinese: 我决定不了选哪个口味的冰淇淋，因为看起来都太好吃了，而且我身后的队伍动得飞快。

sentences.english: You're the best friend ever.
sentences.chinese: 你是史上最好的朋友。

sentences.english: She's the best player on the team and always scores the most goals.
sentences.chinese: 她是队里最棒的球员，进的球总是最多。

sentences.english: Even though I didn't win the race, I did my best and felt proud because I knew I had practiced really hard for months.
sentences.chinese: 尽管我没赢比赛，但我尽力了，而且很骄傲，因为我知道自己刻苦练习了好几个月。

sentences.english: Look, it's starting to snow outside!
sentences.chinese: 看，外面开始下雪了！

sentences.english: The first snow of the year always makes the whole city feel quiet and calm.
sentences.chinese: 每年第一场雪总让整座城市变得安静而平和。

sentences.english: I woke up to find the yard covered in fresh snow, and everything looked so beautiful that I just stood by the window with a cup of coffee for an hour.
sentences.chinese: 我醒来发现院子里盖满了新雪，一切看起来太美了，我就端着杯咖啡在窗前站了整整一小时。

sentences.english: Good job on your test, sweetie!
sentences.chinese: 宝贝，考试考得不错！

sentences.english: The boss said 'good job' to everyone after we finished the big project on time.
sentences.chinese: 我们按时完成大项目后，老板对大家说了“干得好”。

sentences.english: My little daughter drew a picture for me, and I told her 'good job' even though I couldn't tell if it was a cat or a dog, and she was so proud of herself.
sentences.chinese: 小女儿给我画了幅画，虽然我分不清是猫还是狗，我还是夸她“画得真棒”，她自豪极了。

sentences.english: I'm tired because I slept late.
sentences.chinese: 我累了，因为睡得晚。

sentences.english: We stayed inside all day because it was raining heavily.
sentences.chinese: 我们一整天都待在家里，因为外面下着大雨。

sentences.english: I couldn't call you yesterday because my phone ran out of battery and I left my charger at home, so I had to wait until I got back to my apartment to contact you.
sentences.chinese: 我昨天没法给你打电话，因为手机没电了，充电器又忘在家里，所以只能等回公寓充电后才能联系你。

sentences.english: I really need a vacation soon.
sentences.chinese: 我真的需要马上休个假。

sentences.english: We're planning a family vacation to the mountains this summer.
sentences.chinese: 今年夏天我们计划全家去山里度假。

sentences.english: My favorite vacation was when we rented a tiny beach house and did nothing but swim, read books, and eat fresh seafood for a whole week.
sentences.chinese: 我最喜欢的一个假期是我们租了个小小的海边小屋，整整一周除了游泳、看书就是吃新鲜海鲜。

sentences.english: All my friends are coming over.
sentences.chinese: 我所有的朋友都会过来。

sentences.english: I spent all afternoon cleaning the garage, and now I'm exhausted.
sentences.chinese: 我花了一整个下午打扫车库，现在累坏了。

sentences.english: All I want for my birthday is to have a quiet dinner with my family and play board games like we used to when I was a kid.
sentences.chinese: 我生日唯一想要的，就是和家人安安静静吃顿饭，像小时候那样玩玩桌游。

sentences.english: She wore a bright pink dress.
sentences.chinese: 她穿了一件亮粉色的裙子。

sentences.english: The sky turned pink and orange during the sunset, and it took my breath away.
sentences.chinese: 日落时分天空变成了粉色和橘色，美得令我屏息。

sentences.english: My little sister insisted on painting her room bright pink because she says it's the color of princesses and cotton candy.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹坚持要把房间刷成亮粉色，因为她说那是公主和棉花糖的颜色。

sentences.english: We had a lovely time today.
sentences.chinese: 我们今天过得很愉快。

sentences.english: You look lovely in that sweater; it really brings out your eyes.
sentences.chinese: 你穿那件毛衣真好看，特别衬你的眼睛。

sentences.english: We took a walk through the garden, and it was so lovely with all the roses in bloom that we completely lost track of time.
sentences.chinese: 我们在花园里散步，玫瑰盛开的景象太迷人了，以至于我们完全忘记了时间。

sentences.english: A yellow leaf fell on my shoulder.
sentences.chinese: 一片黄叶落在了我的肩上。

sentences.english: The ground was completely covered with brown and red leaves after the storm.
sentences.chinese: 暴风雨过后，地面完全被棕色和红色的落叶覆盖了。

sentences.english: I picked up a perfect maple leaf during my morning walk and pressed it inside my favorite book to remember this beautiful autumn day.
sentences.chinese: 清晨散步时，我捡起一片完美的枫叶，夹在最喜欢的一本书里，用来记住这个美丽的秋日。

sentences.english: Fall is my favorite season.
sentences.chinese: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

sentences.english: I love going to the pumpkin patch with my family every fall.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢每年秋天和全家一起去南瓜园。

sentences.english: Every fall, my neighborhood holds a harvest festival with apple cider, hayrides, and a contest for the biggest pumpkin.
sentences.chinese: 每年秋天，我家小区都会举办丰收节，有苹果酒、坐干草车，还有最大南瓜比赛。

sentences.english: Let's paint the wall light blue.
sentences.chinese: 我们把墙刷成浅蓝色吧。

sentences.english: The kids love to paint with their fingers and make a huge mess.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们喜欢用手指画画，把到处弄得乱糟糟的。

sentences.english: We spent the whole weekend painting the living room, and when we were finally done, it looked like a completely different and much brighter house.
sentences.chinese: 我们花了一整个周末粉刷客厅，终于完工时，房子看起来完全不同了，明亮了许多。
